captions.title: Before training
captions.body: The robot's brain is a random neural network: every robot falls at once

captions.title: Learning by trial and error
captions.body: 4096 robots practise at the same time. Falling costs points, walking earns them

captions.title: Every robot gets a different world
captions.body: Icy to grippy floors, light to heavy bodies, random shoves

captions.title: Harder ground as it improves
captions.body: Robots that walk well are moved to steeper stairs and rougher ground

captions.title: One brain for all terrain
captions.body: It is never told what the ground is like, it adapts by feel

captions.title: Slippery floor
captions.body: It practised on floors this slippery during training

captions.title: Heavy load
captions.body: Trained with -5 to +15 kg extra, so it adjusts by itself

captions.title: Shoves
captions.body: Random pushes in training taught it to catch its balance

captions.title: Everything at once
captions.body: Training mixed these randomly, so it copes with combinations

captions.title: Stairs
captions.body: Learned on the stair levels of the training ground
